WITH event_avg_ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        e.event_id,
        e.location,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN b.amount = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (b.spent - b.amount) / b.amount 
        END) as avg_ratio
    FROM event e
    INNER JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
),
ranked_events AS (
    SELECT 
        event_id,
        location,
        avg_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) as rank
    FROM event_avg_ratios
)
SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    avg_ratio as average_ratio,
    rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank;
